First, we use the identity $1+{cot}^{2}⁡\theta ={csc}^{2}⁡\theta ,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}1+{cot}^{2}⁡\theta +{cot}^{2}⁡\theta \,{csc}^{2}⁡\theta  & =[1+{cot}^{2}⁡\theta ]+{cot}^{2}⁡\theta \,{csc}^{2}⁡\theta  \\  & ={csc}^{2}⁡\theta +{cot}^{2}⁡\theta \,{csc}^{2}⁡\theta \end{aligned}
$$

Now, we factor out ${csc}^{2}⁡\theta ,$ and we use the identity $1+{cot}^{2}⁡\theta ={csc}^{2}⁡\theta $ again. This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{csc}^{2}⁡\theta +{cot}^{2}⁡\theta \,{csc}^{2}⁡\theta  & ={csc}^{2}⁡\theta (1+{cot}^{2}⁡\theta ) \\  & ={csc}^{2}⁡\theta \,({csc}^{2}⁡\theta )\, \\  & ={csc}^{4}⁡\theta .\end{aligned}
$$
